question: Which of the below is a psychological disorder of refusal to eat food, caused by undernutrition?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anorexia Nervosa**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anorexia Nervosa**:

 
 
• A psychologica**l disorder characterized by an intense fear of gaining weight, **leading to refusal to eat and severe undernutrition.
 
• It is often linked to body image issues.
 
• **Individuals with anorexia nervosa have a fear of being overweight or being seen as such, despite the fact that they are typically underweight**
 
• Medical treatment may be required to restore normal weight. Talk therapy can help with self-esteem and behavioural changes.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kwashiorkor**:

 
 
• A form of malnutrition caused by severe protein deficiency, typically seen in children.
 
• It leads to symptoms like swelling (edema), an enlarged liver, and skin changes.
 
 
 
• **Bulimia Nervosa**:
 
 
• A psychological disorder involving binge eating followed by compensatory behaviors like purging, excessive exercise, or fasting.
 
 
 
• **Marasmus**:
 
 
• A severe form of malnutrition caused by a general lack of calories and nutrients,
 
• It leads to extreme wasting and stunted growth, especially in children.
